Safehire provides Digital Risk Screening for organizations vetting people who will access vulnerable populations, sensitive systems, or regulated roles. Its searches sweep lawfully accessible surface, deep, and dark web sources, with AI flagging potential exposure and human analysts verifying context before findings are documented.
